messages:
Ava Morgan: Heads-up 1 I opened a small PR to update the locale-picker accessibility notes and clarify how the SDK 'region' option maps to outgoing headers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4112
DocsBot: PR opened by Ava Morgan: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4112 (CI queued)
Liam O'Connor: Thanks. I'll check the a11y wording and the example code. Do we need both Accept-Language and a note about 'region' vs 'X-Region-Preference'?
Ava Morgan: Yes. Show Accept-Language for browser clients and the SDK option 'region' for server-side samples. Add a short table mapping config -> HTTP header.
Nora Patel: Quick UX note: on the locale picker page, the keyboard focus order is wrong in the current screenshots. I replaced the screenshot in the PR with a keyboard-flow animated gif.
Evan Chu: Small nit: our Node SDK internally sets the header 'region' (lowercase) not X-Region-Preference. We should show both variants in examples to avoid confusion.
Liam O'Connor: I'll change the code snippets to show (1) SDK client config; (2) raw fetch request with Accept-Language and region header; (3) curl example. Keep each snippet to 2-3 lines.
Ava Morgan: Also add a clarifying sentence: "Selecting a docs region changes which regional docs landing page you reach; it does not move or change where your account data is stored unless you have an explicit data residency config." Link to /legal/data-residency.
Nora Patel: Accessibility check: animated gif demonstrates tab order, alt text added, and contrast passes. I left a comment asking for a visible focus ring color to match brand tokens.
Evan Chu: I pushed a tiny update to the Node snippet in the PR comment: ```js
const client = new Redwood({ region: 'eu-central', language: 'de' });
fetch('/api/docs', { headers: { 'Accept-Language': 'de', 'region': 'eu-central' }});
```
Liam O'Connor: LGTM. I ran the content linter and fixed a stray curly quote. Added the mapping table as Markdown in the PR body.
Ava Morgan: CI green. Can someone volunteer to do a quick staging smoke test for the gif and header behavior? If all good we'll merge and add a tiny changelog entry.
Evan Chu: I'll run staging now and report back in 5m.
Evan Chu: Staging: gif loads, focus order correct, fetch shows region header set and Accept-Language honored. Small spacing tweak in the mapping table I pushed.
Ava Morgan: Awesome 1 Merged PR #4112 and added changelog note for next docs release. Thanks all 44D Closing thread.
